research_question: Does canonical aggregate time-series momentum provide a causal, post-publication crisis-defense overlay after equity stress is already observable?
claim_limit: Crisis-defense overlay only; not an early-crash predictor, ticker selector, exact market direction forecast, or capital authorization.

candidate_selection.candidate: AQR aggregate TSMOM monthly excess return
candidate_selection.reason: Canonical literature-defined strategy; selected before opening this conditional outcome battery, not selected from this battery's results.

data.availability: Equity stress state for month t uses prices through month t-1 only; TSMOM outcome is month t.

predefined_states.definition: prior-month SP500 drawdown from trailing 12-month high <= -10%
prior-month SP500 drawdown from trailing 12-month high <= -15%

primary_outcomes: mean monthly TSMOM excess return > 0 in both validation and lockbox
HAC one-sided simultaneous lower bound > 0 in both validation and lockbox
positive-year fraction >= 0.5 where at least two stress months exist in a year

cost_stress.reason: Bundled factor returns do not provide realized turnover/cost vintages; cost is not used to redefine the market claim.

promotion_gate.market_claim_proven: all primary outcomes pass in validation and lockbox for at least one frozen state

forbidden: using contemporaneous SP500 return to label the same month's state
selecting the best state without family correction
calling crisis defense an early crash predictor
